summary: Executed focused backend+frontend regression for Org Config ownership of workflow/framework settings. Backend passed 8/9 tests; frontend confirmed control relocation and visibility in Org Config Features.

critical.issue: CORS returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for trusted-origin preflight instead of explicit origin while credentials are expected.

integration_issues.flow: Super Admin Organization edit form payload inspection
integration_issues.issue: Playwright route interception captured PUT trigger but payload parsing in-run was inconclusive due script/runtime scoping; relied on code review + UI removal checks for non-submission confidence.

issues: Console shows hydration/DOM nesting warnings around select/option markup while dialog is open.
DialogContent accessibility warning: missing description/aria-describedby in console.

action_items: Fix auth CORS policy to return explicit allowed origin (not '*') for credentialed flows.
Optionally add a dedicated test-only data-testid/network hook to reliably assert OrganizationManagement submit payload exclusions in browser automation.
Review and resolve select/dialog console accessibility/hydration warnings in OrganizationManagement modal.
critical_code_review_comments: OrganizationManagement form state and submit payload do not include approval_workflow_enabled, multi_level_approval_enabled, or esg_frameworks_enabled (expected removal confirmed by code).
Org Config contracts correctly constrain organization_settings.esg_frameworks_enabled to Literal['BRSR','GRI'].
organization/module-config now reads workflow/framework values via resolve_organization_settings (canonical org_config path), matching requested ownership shift.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned temporary legacy org/config records during migration-read test (TEST_LEGACY_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file includes restore fixture for admin org canonical+legacy settings. Frontend paths are /super-admin/organizations and /super-admin/org-config (not /organizations or /org-config).
rca of the issue: CORS failure RCA: auth preflight currently responds with wildcard origin, which conflicts with strict credentialed-origin requirements in the auth playbook. Repro: OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://esg-ai-routing.preview.emergentagent.com + Access-Control-Request-Method: POST returns ACAO='*'. Mitigation: configure explicit allowlist origin reflection with allow_credentials=true.
